name: two_his_xn_typing
description: Discovery mode, not classification mode: find every 2-His site with the same beta-strand geometry and report what else is in its first coordination shell (2His-Xn, n = 0..4). Use to survey a superfold's metal-site diversity, to find which coordination environments are unexpectedly common or rare, and to generate hypotheses for new motif specs. Corresponds to Extended Data Fig. 10 of Kipouros & Chang 2026.
